# hippius-drive

> Python SDK and CLI for Hippius Drive. Files are encrypted on the machine that holds the recovery phrase. The server stores ciphertext.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

## What it is and what it does

A scriptable client for the same Drive a person sees in the console, the desktop app, and the Android app. It is alpha. The sync engine and recovery bindings are not in this version.

Drive is not S3. A file put through this SDK does not appear in an S3 bucket.

## How to install

It is not on PyPI. Install from this repository:

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-drive-sdk"
```

Python 3.10 to 3.13.

## How to sign in

The caller needs three things that belong together:

- An API token from https://console.hippius.com/dashboard/settings
- The account address that token belongs to
- The recovery phrase for the Drive

An agent with its own 12-word access key signs in without a browser: `pip install "hippius-drive[login] @ git+https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-drive-sdk"`, then `hippius-drive auth login --phrase-file FILE` (or `hippius_drive.auth.login(phrase)` in code). It saves the token and address to `~/.config/hippius-drive/config.toml` (0600) and prints neither. Keep the access key in an owner-only file, never on the command line. Join a shared drive the same way: `hippius-drive drives join --invite-file FILE` (the URL in an owner-only file, or `HIPPIUS_INVITE_URL`).

The phrase never leaves the user's machine. Do not ask them to paste it into chat. Read it from their environment if they have already stored it there.

```python
from pathlib import Path
from hippius_drive import Client, Identity

identity = Identity.from_master(master_phrase, "default", account_ss58=account)
with Client(token=token, identity=identity) as client:
    client.folders.register()
    client.files.put(Path("report.pdf"), "work/report.pdf")
```

A token and an address that do not belong together fail the first request with 403.

## Share link insights and comments

A file share's views, viewers, comments and reactions:

```bash
hippius-drive share settings TOKEN --insights on --comments on   # paid Drive plan
hippius-drive share insights TOKEN
hippius-drive share comments --url-file link.txt                  # or HIPPIUS_SHARE_URL
hippius-drive share comment-post "see 0:42" --url-file link.txt
hippius-drive share reactions TOKEN
hippius-drive share react 🔥 TOKEN                                # unreact, moments, block, unblock, seen
```

Comments are encrypted under the link's key, so reading or posting them needs the share URL (in an owner-only file or `HIPPIUS_SHARE_URL`, never on the command line). For the owner's own console link, `TOKEN` alone works: the URL is rebuilt from the owner wrap. On the Free Drive plan switches stay off (`403 paid_plan_required`) and insights show counts only. A `#p=` link's password goes in `HIPPIUS_SHARE_PASSWORD`. In code: `client.shares.update_settings`, `insights`, `viewer_names`, `comments`, `post_comment`, `delete_comment`, `reactions`, `react`, `unreact`, `react_at`, `reaction_moments`, `block_author`, `unblock_author`, `mark_insights_seen`, `recover_url`.

Paying and plans: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/billing
What the console Drive UI does: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/drive
